class.name: IfcBoundaryNodeConditionWarping
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Describes linearly elastic support conditions or connection conditions, including linearly elastic warping restraints. Applicability: Point supports and connections. HISTORY: New entity in IFC 2x2. IFC 2x4 change: All attribute data types changed from numeric to SELECT between Boolean and numeric. Stiffnesses may now also be negative, for example to capture destabilizing effec

members.member: Defines the warping stiffness value. A value (String, float, int or bool) in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a float in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.
